milestones.outcome: Operators can safely export a bounded CSV through the public CLI.
exit_criteria: The public single-file path preserves destination ownership and exact output/job limits.
milestones.boundary: A usable single-file export before the batch increment.

milestones.outcome: Operators can resume bounded batches without duplicate output.
exit_criteria: Public batch/resume paths satisfy partition, interruption and identity behavior.
